title: The Weekly Competitor Intelligence Brief
pitch: last30days pulls together everything being said about a brand or competitor across Reddit, X, YouTube, and Hacker News in the last 30 days; open-seo audits that same competitor's organic search position, content gaps, and keyword rankings. Stitch both outputs into one automated weekly PDF brief — 'here's what people are saying about you and where you actually rank' — and sell it as a subscription to marketing agencies serving small-business clients who currently can't afford both a social-listening tool and an SEO platform.
why_now: Both trended today for complementary reasons — one covers public sentiment across social platforms, the other covers organic search performance — bundling them turns two separate subscriptions a small agency can't justify into one combined offering they can.
